Display.DriverPresetTip: Fills the driver color sliders below (hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, temperature) with a ready-made look. Press Apply to use it; adjust any slider afterwards.
Tuning.FanUnsupported: The driver did not report manual fan control for this GPU. See Settings > Diagnostics.
Tuning.FanPresetTip: GPU default restores the curve the driver had when the app started. Optimized ramps from 30% at 40 °C to 100% at 80 °C.
Settings.OverheatAlways: Keep the warning on while hot
Settings.OverheatAlwaysTip: The notice stays on screen and updates the temperature until the GPU cools down.
Settings.OverheatTip: Shows an overlay notice when the GPU reaches this temperature. Off by default; 80 °C is a common safe limit.
Tip.SurfaceFormat: Lets the driver use faster surface formats in some games.
Tip.TripleBuffer: Smoother vertical sync in OpenGL games, at the cost of a little video memory.
Tip.Tess: Limits how much geometry detail the game may add. AMD optimized is usually best.
Tip.Af: Sharper textures at an angle. Pick the level on the right.
Tip.Mlaa: Post-process edge smoothing done by the driver.
Tip.AaLevel: Sample count used when the driver overrides or enhances anti-aliasing.
Tip.AaMethod: Sampling method used when the driver overrides or enhances anti-aliasing.
Tip.AaMode: How the driver treats the game's own anti-aliasing.
Tuning.FrtcFailed: The driver did not accept the FPS limit.
Tip.FrtcGlobal: One cap for every game, applied right away and when the app starts. For a per-game limiter use Radeon Chill.

Dashboard.ActiveAppNone: Waiting for a configured app to start
Dashboard.NoAdlxMsg: Controls that require ADLX are unavailable. See Settings > Diagnostics.
Graphics.Title: Graphics
Graphics.Subtitle: Global driver settings. Changes apply per your apply mode (Settings).
Graphics.NoFeatures: No 3D features were reported by the driver.
Graphics.SamNote: Resizable BAR / SAM is enabled in the BIOS (Above 4G Decoding + Resizable BAR). This is shown for information only.
Graphics.SamUnsupported: The driver did not report the Resizable BAR state. Enable it in the BIOS if your platform supports it.
Tip.Afmf: Driver-level frame generation for DX11/DX12/Vulkan games.
Tip.Fsr: Upgrades supported games to the latest ML-based FSR (same option as in AMD Software, "Enable if supported"). Needs an RDNA 2 or newer GPU (RX 6000 and up). Enable FSR 3.1 or newer in the game itself first; a game restart may be needed. Applied straight in the GPU driver when the game starts (no AMD Software needed). Restart the game if it was already open.
Tip.EnhancedSync: Reduces tearing with less latency than V-Sync.
Tip.Boost: Lowers resolution dynamically during fast motion.
Tip.Chill: Dynamic FPS limiter based on input. Exclusive with FRTC.
Tip.Frtc: Fixed FPS cap. Exclusive with Chill.
Tip.Sam: Lets the CPU access all VRAM.

Settings.ApplyOnStartup: Apply saved profile when the app starts
Settings.RestoreOnExit: Restore previous values when the app closes

Settings.BackendChanged: Backend saved. Click "Reinitialize ADLX" to use it.
Settings.ReinitFail: ADLX could not be initialized. See diagnostics below.

Tuning.KeepMin: Keep min clock 100 MHz below max
Tuning.KeepMinTip: Min follows the max clock box (the card default unless you change it). Keeps the GPU from dropping to idle clocks.
Presets.Title: Quick presets
Presets.Unsupported: This GPU does not expose tuning for presets
Safe.Title: Keep these settings?
Safe.Text: Reverting automatically in {0} seconds if you do not confirm.
Recovery.Title: Last tuning was not confirmed
Recovery.Text: The app closed or the PC restarted before the last tuning change was confirmed. To be safe, nothing was applied automatically this time. Lower your values and try again.
Settings.AdvancedTip: Shows Display and Profiles pages, image quality options, VRAM, fan curve and voltage states.
Settings.AutoRevert: Auto revert tuning if not confirmed
Settings.AutoRevertTip: After applying tuning you have 15 seconds to confirm, otherwise the previous values return.
Graphics.Unsupported: Not exposed by this GPU or driver through ADLX: {0}. (The FSR upgrade needs a newer driver, for example Adrenalin 26.10.1 or newer on RX 6000.)
Apps.FsrOldGpu: The FSR 4 upgrade needs an RDNA 2 or newer GPU (RX 6000 and up). Your GPU ({0}) does not support it, so this option is disabled. Everything else on this page still works.
Common.ApplyTip: Sends the values on this page to the driver.
Common.ReloadFromDriverTip: Discards your edits and reads the current values from the driver.
Display.SelectTip: Choose which monitor these options apply to.
Display.FreeSyncTip: Variable refresh rate: the monitor refresh follows the frame rate to avoid tearing and stutter. Only shown when the monitor and GPU support it.
Display.VsrTip: Virtual Super Resolution: renders above the monitor resolution and scales down for a sharper image. Needs GPU Scaling on; once enabled, the higher resolutions show up in the Windows display settings.
Display.GpuScalingTip: The GPU scales lower resolutions instead of the monitor. Turn this on first: it unlocks VSR, integer scaling and the scaling mode.
Display.IntegerScalingTip: Scales by whole numbers so pixels stay sharp (good for pixel art).
Display.ScalingModeTip: How the image is fitted when the resolution is not native: full panel, keep aspect ratio or centered.
Display.HueTip: Shifts all colors around the color wheel.
Display.ContrastTip: Difference between the darkest and the brightest areas.
Display.TemperatureTip: Color temperature in Kelvin: lower is warmer (yellow), higher is cooler (blue).
Display.ColorProfileTip: The only global 3D-independent setting: a color profile applied through the Windows gamma ramp.
Settings.ApplyModeTip: Instant sends every change right away. Manual waits for the Apply button.
Settings.LiveUndervoltTip: Sends voltage and power changes while you drag, after you pause for a moment. Use with care.
Settings.ApplyOnStartupTip: Re-applies your saved tuning and color when the app starts, since the driver forgets them on reboot.
Settings.PerAppTip: Watches running programs and applies the matching profile. The app must stay in the tray.
Settings.RestoreOnExitTip: Puts the previous driver values back when the game closes.
Settings.NotifyOnProfile: Show overlay when a game profile starts
Settings.NotifyOnProfileTip: Draws a small overlay in the top left corner of the game screen listing which technologies the profile turned on or off. Click-through, it never takes focus.
Settings.StartWithWindowsTip: Starts the app in the tray when you sign in so profiles and tuning are applied.
Settings.StartMinimizedTip: Starts hidden in the tray instead of opening the window.
Settings.BackendTip: Where the app talks to the driver. Automatic uses the AMD driver DLL, which works with a driver-only install.
Settings.GpuTip: Which GPU the app controls when you have more than one.
Settings.SensorIntervalTip: How often sensors are read. Longer intervals use less CPU.
Settings.ReinitTip: Reloads the driver connection without restarting the app.
Settings.ClearShaderTip: Deletes shader caches. Games rebuild them on the next launch (can cause brief stutter).
Settings.CopyDiagTip: Copies the diagnostics text so you can paste it in a report.
Settings.OpenLogsTip: Opens the folder with the app logs.
Settings.UpdateAutoTip: Asks GitHub for the project releases when the app starts and tells you when a newer version is out. Nothing is downloaded without your confirmation.
Settings.UpdateLatest: Version {0} — you are on the latest one.
Update.Confirm: Download and open version {0}? Close the app to install it.
Update.Started: Download finished — the installer was opened.
Tuning.PresetTip: Applies one of the driver tuning presets (Power Saver, Quiet, Balanced, Turbo, Rage). The preset sets clocks, power and fan on its own, so choosing one applies only the preset. Press Apply, and the controls below then show the values it set. Editing any control afterwards switches back to manual tuning.
Tuning.GpuMinTip: Lowest clock the GPU core may use.
Tuning.GpuMaxTip: Highest clock the GPU core may reach. Lowering it together with the voltage is how you undervolt.
Tuning.VoltageTip: Maximum core voltage. A lower value gives less heat and power, but too low can crash.
Tuning.PowerLimitTip: Board power limit relative to stock. Negative saves power, positive allows more.
Tuning.UniformOffsetTip: Linear change: moves the whole curve by the same amount from the reference value.
Tuning.OffsetTip: Linear step: lowers voltage (and the clock proportionally on state-based GPUs) in one go.
Tuning.VramTimingTip: Memory timing level. Tighter timings can be faster but less stable.
Tuning.ZeroRpmTip: Fans stop completely below a temperature threshold.
Tuning.ResetFactoryTip: Returns clocks, voltage, power, memory and fan to factory values.
Tuning.MmChartTip: Core clock (X) against voltage (Y). The top point is your max clock and max voltage: drag it alone to edit both manually. Select several points to shift them linearly. Click a point and drag to edit it manually. To change several at once, select them (click, or drag a box; Ctrl adds, Ctrl+A selects all, Esc clears), then drag, use the mouse wheel or Up/Down: they move linearly, voltage and clock together (Shift = 1 unit). The dashed curve shows how it was before.
Tuning.VfChartTip: Frequency (X) against voltage (Y) for each state. Drag one point to edit it freely. Select several points to move them linearly (voltage and clock together). Click a point and drag to edit it manually. To change several at once, select them (click, or drag a box; Ctrl adds, Ctrl+A selects all, Esc clears), then drag, use the mouse wheel or Up/Down: they move linearly, voltage and clock together (Shift = 1 unit). The dashed curve shows how it was before.
Tuning.FanChartTip: Fan speed (Y) against temperature (X). Drag points; points after a 100% point are raised to 100%.
StatTip.GpuUsage: How busy the GPU core is.
StatTip.TempEdge: Edge temperature: the sensor at the edge of the GPU die.
StatTip.TempHotspot: Hotspot (junction): the hottest point of the die. Usually 10 to 25 degrees above the edge.
StatTip.TempMemory: Video memory temperature (shown only if your card has this sensor).
StatTip.Power: Power drawn by the GPU (or the whole board when available).
StatTip.Fan: Fan speed in revolutions per minute.
InfoTip.DeviceId: PCI vendor and device ID, used to tell which GPU generation you have.
InfoTip.Type: Discrete cards have their own memory; integrated ones share system RAM.
InfoTip.Bios: Video BIOS version of the card.
InfoTip.Backend: Where the app reads and writes settings. ADLX comes with the display driver itself.
InfoTip.Sam: Smart Access Memory (Resizable BAR): lets the CPU access all video memory.
Tip.BoostRes: Lowest resolution Radeon Boost may drop to, as a percentage.
Tip.VSync: How the game waits for the monitor refresh. Off gives the lowest latency but may tear.
Tip.ChillMin: Frame rate when there is no input.
Tip.FrtcFps: Frame rate cap in frames per second.
Tip.PowerLimit: Power limit applied only while this game runs. Empty keeps your global value.
Tip.TuningPreset: Driver tuning preset applied only while this game runs.
Apps.AddTip: Pick a game .exe or a .lnk shortcut. You can also drop it on this page.
Apps.EnabledTip: Turns this profile on or off without deleting it.
Apps.DropHint: Or drop a .exe / shortcut anywhere on this page.
Apps.UrlUnsupported: Internet shortcuts (.url) do not point to an executable. Drop the game .exe or a Windows shortcut (.lnk) instead.
Apps.FsrNotExposed: Your driver (ADLX {0}) does not expose the FSR 4 upgrade, so it cannot be toggled from here. Everything else on this page works.
Notify.Title: {0}: profile active
Notify.Nothing: No options set for this profile
Settings.OverlaySecondsTip: How long the overlay stays visible after the game starts. Default 3 seconds.
Settings.OverlayTestTip: Shows the overlay now with sample data so you can see it and check the duration.
Apps.QuickTitleTip: One click fills the options below with common choices. It replaces this profile's options, and you can still fine tune each one afterwards.
Apps.PresetCompetitiveTip: Lowest latency: Anti-Lag on, V-Sync and Enhanced Sync off, no frame rate cap.
Apps.Preset60Tip: Caps the frame rate at 60 FPS with Anti-Lag on. The most common choice.
Apps.PresetSaverTip: Radeon Chill between 60 and 90 FPS to cut power and heat.
Apps.PresetQualityTip: Image Sharpening at 80% and the FSR upgrade (when available).
Apps.PresetClearTip: Removes every option from this profile, so the driver defaults are used.
Apps.FsrViaDriver: Applied straight in the GPU driver when the game starts (no AMD Software needed). Restart the game if it was already open.
Apps.FsrDriverOnly: The driver on this PC does not report the FSR upgrade as supported, so it cannot be set here.
Settings.OverlayCornerTip: Which part of the screen shows the overlay when a game profile starts. Changing it shows a preview.
Apps.KeepAfterExit: Keep these settings after the game closes (global)
Apps.KeepAfterExitTip: When on, the options are not restored when the game closes and stay in effect for everything until another profile changes them. Use it if a game only picks up FRTC, AFMF or FSR when they were already set before it started.
Tip.CurveChart: Click a point and drag to edit it. Select several with Ctrl or a drag box, then drag, use the mouse wheel or Up/Down to move them together.
Settings.AutoReset: Reset to factory if the GPU driver crashes
Settings.AutoResetTip: Watches Windows for the video driver stopping and recovering (TDR). If that happens while an undervolt or overclock is active, the app returns the GPU to factory values and clears the saved tuning. It listens for events only, so it uses almost no CPU or RAM.
Notify.UnstableKept: Tuning could not be reset, open the app
